summary: Ardagh Metal Packaging S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on June 4, 2026. Shareholders approved all eight proposals, including re-election of directors Oliver Graham, Stefan Schellinger, and Mark Porto; ratification of interim dividends; and appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers as statutory auditor. All proposals received over 92% of votes cast. This is a routine foreign private issuer report of ordinary meeting outcomes, not a special situation. Filing maps to a US 8-K Item 5.07 submission of meeting results.
